record.name: GitHub
record.one_liner: GitHub REST API for creating integrations, retrieving data, and automating workflows.

auth.notes: Supports OAuth 2.0 via OAuth apps and GitHub Apps, as well as personal access tokens (classic and fine-grained).

access.notes: Developers can create and register OAuth apps and personal access tokens directly from their account settings without special gated approvals.

api_surface.notes: REST API documentation and JavaScript SDK (Octokit.js) are explicitly mentioned and detailed.

mcp.notes: Model Context Protocol is not mentioned in the provided text.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials can be generated directly via account settings, and comprehensive REST API documentation is available.

evidence.claim: The GitHub REST API documentation provides guidance on creating integrations, retrieving data, and automating workflows.
Developers can create and register an OAuth app under their personal account or organization.
Personal access tokens can be used for authentication to the GitHub API.
Provides quickstart documentation for using the GitHub REST API with GitHub CLI, curl, or Octokit.js.
